import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem sprint_development_0053 {α : Type u} [hα : Fintype α] {l : List α} {n : α} (hn : n ∉ l) : (n :: l).Nodup := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem sprint_development_0053 {α : Type u} [hα : Fintype α] {l : List α} {n : α} (hn : n ∉ l) : (n :: l).Nodup := by
  apply List.Nodup.cons
  assumption
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0053 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0053 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0053

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0053
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0053
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
